hypothesis: One-token speculative verification can amortize CPU expert weight reads enough to exceed draft and recurrent rollback costs. No new weights or arithmetic changes.
protocol: Manual sequential requests, fresh process per profile, fixed EXP107 full-context placement. One diagnostic screen per profile; no performance promotion from single observations. Verify greedy token IDs and target top5 probability deltas <=0.001; report failures without relaxing tolerance. Separate matched-prefix regression and temperature1 stochastic check only for eligible candidates.
stop: Stop a failing profile without a tuning sweep. No downloads or baseline change. Restore accepted EXP107.

excluded.draft-simple: No compatible small draft selected; no unapproved weights download.
